"'''Unfinished Business'''" is an episode of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="Legacy" /> It premiered in story reel form on [[April 17]], [[2015]] at [[Celebration Anaheim (2015)|Celebration Anaheim]],<ref name="Anaheim Announcement" /> and it was later released online on [[April 29]], 2015.<ref name="SW.com" /><ref name="Legacy" />

On [[April 14]], [[2019]], it was revealed at [[Celebration Chicago]] that a finalized version of the Bad Batch arc would be part of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|''Star Wars'': ''The Clone Wars'' revival season]].<ref name="TCW revival" /> It was released on [[March 13]], 2020.<ref name="March" />

This episode is chronologically followed by [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|Season Seven's]] ninth episode, "[[Old Friends Not Forgotten]]."

==Official description==
===Original===
"''The Republic plans a daring final strike against Wat Tambor and Admiral Trench, once again bringing together Rex, Echo, Anakin Skywalker, and the elite Bad Batch squad''."<ref name="Story Reel" />

===Disney+===
''Anakin Skywalker and the Bad Batch attempt to gain a victory for the Republic''.<ref name="March" />

==Opening narration==
{{OpeningCrawl
|name=UNFINISHED BUSINESS
|text=Reunited! With the help of the Bad Batch, Captain Rex rescues his old friend, ARC Trooper Echo, from the Techno Union. The Separatists' loss of Echo's strategic algorithm provides a chance for the Republic to turn the tide in the Battle for Anaxes.

However, Echo's horrifying experience behind enemy lines leaves lingering questions of his true loyalty and uncertain future....}}

==Plot summary==
{{Quote|I am not a liability, Rex. I'm the best chance we have to take back Anaxes.|Clone trooper Echo, to Captain Rex|<ref name="Unfinished Business" />}}
At [[Fort Anaxes]], the [[Jedi Master]]s [[Mace Windu]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] brief [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Rex]] about their plan to retake Anaxes from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatists]]. The newly-rescued [[Echo]] offers to assist the war effort, but Rex cautions his comrade that he is not yet ready but Windu expresses interest in hearing Echo's plan. Echo's plan is to infiltrate the Separatist [[Admiral]] [[Trench]]'s [[Providence-class Dreadnought|dreadnought]] above Anaxes and mislead him by feeding the Separatist systems false strategies in order to secure a Republic victory on Anaxes. Windu and Kenobi consent to the plan.

Skywalker, Rex, Echo, and the [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch]] depart for their mission aboard the [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|''Marauder'']]. While flying to the Separatist fleet, [[Wrecker]] moans about being sent on another "stealth mission." The clones managed to obtain permission to dock with the Separatist dreadnought after Echo transmits a signal cloaking their ship as the Separatist shuttle TC-59. Meanwhile on Anaxes, Republic forces under Masters Windu and Kenobi attack the main [[Anaxes assembly complex|Separatist assembly plant]] with [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry|LAAT gunships]] and [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/bomber]]s. While [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter|ARC-170]] fighters distract the Vulture Droids to buy the Republic time, the Y-wing's begin bombing the plant. Upon entering the assembly plant, Windu offers the [[B1-series battle droid]]s there the chance to surrender and be reprogrammed. However, the droids reject the offer and attack Windu and his men. Meanwhile, the clones use grappling hooks to descend into the factory. On Trench's dreadnought, a [[ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|super tactical droid]] informs the Admiral that the assembly plant has come under attack. Trench smiles and remarks that he will use the Republic's arrogance and desperation to his advantage.

Meanwhile, Echo along with Tech and Anakin infiltrate the dreadnought's interface unit and put their plan into action. Unaware of the [[Mission to Skako Minor (Clone Wars)|recent events]] on [[Skako Minor]], Admiral Trench orders his tactical droid to contact Skako Minor for Echo's algorithm. Tech is able to mask Echo's transmission as originating from Skako Minor, fooling Trench. Posing as the algorithm, Echo advises the Admiral to mobilize all troops to the assembly plant, claiming that the Republic would send all their reinforcements there due to their faith in the Jedi. The Separatist plan was to smash all Republic forces with one strike. Admiral Trench gloats and deploys more reinforcements to the assembly plant. Tech picks up Trench's transmission and informs his comrades. [[Hunter]] initially sees this as a bad sign until Echo explains that his plan to send a feedback pulse to shut down all of the Separatist droids. Anakin then informs Windu and Kenobi about Echo's plan, which they attribute to Skywalker.

Believing victory is imminent, Trench deploys all his forces to the assembly plant. Echo then issues the pulse shutting down all of the Separatist droids. Trench is shocked by the algorithm's failure. The tactical droid then informs him that the source of the pulse originated on his dreadnought. Realizing that intruders are aboard his ship, Trench dispatches battle droids to deal with them. Trench then vows to unleash utter annihilation on his Republic foes. Before the clones can leave, Echo receives a transmission that Trench plans to activate a bomb beneath the assembly plant. Echo resolves to stop Trench's plot while Skywalker makes his way through the ship to confront the Admiral himself.

Back on Anaxes, Windu and Kenobi receive word from the clones that Trench has planted a bomb in the plant's fusion generator, and they need help to disarm it. While Kenobi orders an evacuation of all Republic forces from the plant, Windu descends into the fusion generator to find the bomb, only to find it's protected by a ray shield. While Echo transmits the sequence to shut down the bomb, Windu uses the Force to move the dials. Their work is interrupted when Trench traces down the source of the pulse and jams its signal. This has the effect of electrocuting Echo and rendering him unconscious. The clones are then attacked by several [[B2-series super battle droid]]s and Windu orders them to retreat.

Meanwhile, Admiral Trench orders an assault on Anaxes and sends more battle droids to deal with the clone infiltrators. He attempts to exit the command bridge but is blocked by Anakin, who strikes down his tactical droid and several [[BX-series droid commando]]s with his lightsaber. Anakin then demands that Trench reveal the final number in the sequence to disarm the bomb, but the Admiral only taunts him. In response, Skywalker severs his left set of arms and reiterates his demand. Trench complies and Anakin reveals the final number to Windu who is then able to disarm the bomb. Trench attacks Skywalker with his right set of arms, but the Jedi stabs him in the chest with his lightsaber. Before exiting the command bridge, Anakin steals the remote detonator as a favor for Wrecker, who enjoys blowing things up. Seeing Trench still alive he informs the admiral it was a pleasure, before he drops dead.

Elsewhere on the dreadnought, the clones fight back against countless battle droids. Wrecker charges at the droids and manages to rip several to pieces. Meanwhile, Crosshair plants several detonators on the ship's corridor and a battle droid. Having accomplished their mission, the clones escape with Skywalker on the ''Marauder''. After they depart, Wrecker uses the remote detonator to blow up Trench's dreadnought and several surrounding warships.

[[File:Clone_Force_99_plus_Echo.png|left|thumb|220x220px|Echo, now a member of The Bad Batch, and his new squad-mates salute Rex.]]
Following the battle, Windu, Kenobi, and Skywalker praise the courage and skill of Echo, Rex and the Bad Batch. As the Jedi leave, Obi-Wan mentions that the clones will have some medals on their way soon. However, the Bad Batch isn't planning on attending the ceremony, saying they're not fighting in the war for the sake of medals. Hunter asks Echo if he's sure medals are his thing, either, and elaborates that if he feels he doesn't fit in anywhere else, he should look for them. Rex tells Echo that he considers the Bad Batch some of the finest troopers he's fought alongside, and that he doesn't mind if he goes with them if he wants to. When Echo does choose to go with the Bad Batch, Rex stops to see his friend off, and Echo and the Bad Batch all salute.

==Development==
{{Quote|Learn from the past, but live for the future|Original moral, per the story reel for "Unfinished Business"|<ref name="Unfinished Business" />}}
A completed version of the episode aired as part of ''The Clone Wars'' [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|revival]] on [[Disney+]].<ref name="The Clone Wars panel">{{StarWarsShow|14Fkcyi8E1k|Star Wars Celebration Chicago 2019 Live Stream – Day 3 | The Star Wars Show LIVE!}}</ref>

==Continuity==
[[File:R2D2UnfinishedBuisness.png|thumb|right|250px|The astromech droid that looks like R2-D2]]
There are several differences between the story reel and the finished episode. Among them, Gold Leader is no longer wearing the kind of flight helmet and suit worn by clone pilots in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. The explanation that Trench doesn't know of Echo's rescue because [[Wat Tambor]] is afraid of him has been removed. The medal ceremony at the end has also been removed and replaced with a different scene. One of the [[astromech droid]]s depicted in this scene resembled [[R2-D2]].
